works: Scope note: read-only audit of src/10_save.js, src/11_settings.js, src/20-2e sim files and tools/balance.js on branch v0.9-genres. No repo files were edited. I also ran bot careers from a scratchpad script through tests/_load: 3 seeds x 3 years for each band, avg bot. All four bands start, run and pass the balance invariants with no crashes. The evidence figures quoted in the findings come from that probe.

career.band() / newCareer (src/20_sim_career.js) builds everything from content/bands.js: members, genre, region, city and tier-0 space. Starter songs get genre-correct drum patterns, seeded by title. Choosing a band on the new-career screen only needs the UI to pass bandId.

The card gate system already supports band and genre gates (career.gatePasses GATE.band / GATE.genre). The Monday deck, holiday cards, tour cards, fan cards, shop cards, licensing cards, studio events (labels eventFits) and road cards (world.roadGatePasses) all use it. Per-band content therefore only needs gates, not new code.

Songs (src/21_sim_songs.js) handle all four genres: rate, generate, starter, signature, groove presets and mods, and tempo labels. content/genres.js and content/grooves.js cover all four. pickTitle uses the state.genre pool. Album title words and cover motifs, palettes and fonts are filtered by genre in labels.

Gig sim (src/22_sim_gig.js) is generic: venue genreFit exists for all 4 genres, GENRE_MOMENT plus its result line exists for all 4 (wallOfDeath / circlePit / lighters / lineDance), and charts, the two-thumb rule, doubles, difficulty, pay, fans and performance are genre-agnostic.

gig.roles() already finds front, solo and fill for every lineup: Frost Heave rox/benny/moth, Gravel Kings chase/lenny/tamara, Ramblers travis/earl/clementine. Solo and fill cues and chart easing work for all bands. Lineup sizes (3 or 4 bandmates) work in drama.roles, holes, split and avgSkill.

Van drivers are data-driven. content/road_cards.js GG.content.drivers has all four drivers (kenji, moth, tamara='T-Bone', earl) with mods. world.driver, driverMods, syncDriver, the 'you drive' fallback and road-card driver gates all work. Earl's chemistry mod and Moth's free repair are applied in world.travel and repairQuote.
world.home() = state.city resolves Regina, Swift Current and Edmonton on content/map.js. Gas, km and routes work from any home.

Shop (src/2a_sim_shop.js): the tier-0 space comes from band.space/spaceName (laundromat_basement, strip_mall_unit, quonset). vanNames exist per band per tier in content/shop.js and shop.init renames the van for a new career. Merch honours def.band and def.genre, and every band has its own limited item. Gear names are per genre (china vs ride).

Drama machinery is generic: roles and holes, fill-ins, recruit ads, candidates, hire, pay cut and split, grievance stages and protection. Recruit names and shirt palettes per genre already exist in content/recruits.js.

Rival sim (src/23_sim_rival.js) is generic apart from content: rival id comes from band.rival; the parallel career, heat, scheduling of botb/sameNight/stolenSlot/festival/poach, resolve, crack, the Sad Dome final and Loonie strength all work; name, city and genre come from content.rivals. content/logo.js has fixed logos for all 4 rivals.

Labels (src/24_sim_labels.js) are generic: offers, deals, studio sessions, releases, reviews with genre outlet weights, charts, royalties, certs and Loonies. The album category is genre-prefixed. rivalLines already reads awards.rivalThanks[rivalId] and rivalLoses[rivalId]; only the content is missing.

Tour (src/25_sim_tour.js) is generic: the region fit table covers all four genres, and region unlocks, invites, big-in-one-place, homesickness, the Gong, packages and bots work. Band-gated queued story cards are dropped cleanly.
Calendar (src/28_sim_calendar.js): genreSeason and genreKinds cover all four genres; weather comes from city climate; holidays and the Grey Mug are generic.

Fans (src/29_sim_fans.js): posts, virality, fan types, fan club, mail and gifts, and scandal machinery are generic. Scandals are filtered by isActive(who), so other bands get no bad member-specific scandal, only none.

Creator (src/2b_sim_creator.js) is fully generic: genreStart gates and per-genre carry-over. Logo (src/2e_sim_logo.js) is generic: per-band defaults in content, per-genre carry, rebrand; chat simply skips lines when no member matches.

Licensing (src/2c_sim_licensing.js): brands are genre-weighted, and the Buckle & Boot fury hook plus the lic_fury card (gated to the Ramblers, speaker travis) are already wired. Recap (src/2d_sim_recap.js) numbers and headline events are generic; headlines use {band}.
Save and settings (src/10_save.js, src/11_settings.js): slots, codes, the migration chain and summary are band-agnostic; the summary uses band.name.

findings.assumes: Canada rings open by era with Saskatchewan open from day one (cityOpen/ringOpen). farListings (L248-252) treats any ring other than the home ring as 'far'. For Gravel Kings the home city Edmonton is in ring 'west', which is closed in the garage era. Probe: the Gravel Kings garage-era board averages 1.0 listing at an average of 618 km; over 3 years the band averages 15.5 parents' loans (Hail Damage 0.5) and 424 km per gig.
findings.needs: Code: open the band's home ring from week 1. Define 'far' relative to home (Saskatchewan becomes the far ring for Gravel Kings). Possibly add a per-band ring order in bands.js. Content: tier-1 and tier-2 Edmonton-area venues. Edmonton has only mega_mall_food_court (tier 2) and oilfield_orpheum (tier 3). Consider Alberta satellites (St. Albert, Sherwood Park, Leduc are the members' hometowns). Rebalance world.scene for a non-Saskatchewan home.

findings.assumes: The forced week-1 gig is always buddys_house_party (Saskatoon). Probe: Frost Heave drives 239 km ($120 gas), Gravel Kings 528 km ($264), the Ramblers 245 km. The forced week-1 card is 'lord_abyssus' (Hail Damage only, cards.js L49), so the other bands get no week-1 card.
findings.needs: A band.firstGig field in bands.js, read by newCareer. Frost Heave can use craigs_basement (Regina). The Ramblers can use speedy_creek_skate_bowl or a new farm/Quonset party venue. Gravel Kings needs a new Edmonton house party. Also one forced week-1 intro card per band.

findings.assumes: fillText supports only fixed-id tokens ({name:<id>}, {nick:<id>}). Fallbacks are {rival} -> 'Tundra Wraith' (L125) and {city} -> 'Saskatoon' (L129). Shared content therefore hard-codes Hail Damage names. Probe: other bands see venue quirks like 'Marcel is six foot one', breakdown lines like 'The Moose Hearse died... Kenji', and calendar lines like 'six Marcels'.
findings.needs: Add role and band tokens so shared text can be band-agnostic: {front}, {lead}, {bassist}, {fill}, {driver}, {van}, {space}, {homeVenue}, {superfan}, {rivalFront}. They resolve from gig.roles, world.driver, van.name, band.spaceName and the rival cast. Neutral fallbacks for {rival} and {city}. Then sweep content to use them.
couples: src/29_sim_fans.js fill (gcity 'Saskatoon', venue 'the Legion' fallbacks L99-104)

findings.assumes: Activity block lines (contentLines('activity', id)) are one global pool of Hail Damage text. Weekly chat (postWeeklyChat L788-798) is keyed by member id; only marcel, dana, jaxon and kenji exist, so new members fall back to the generic 3-line FALLBACK_LINES.chat. gigReactions (22_sim_gig L118-124) behave the same way. Probe: 'Kenji stood perfectly still', 'We ran My Lawn, My Tomb eleven times' and 'Baba sent perogies' appear in Frost Heave, Gravel Kings and Ramblers block lines.
findings.needs: Code: a band-scoped content resolver, e.g. lines.bands[bandId][key] before lines[key], or a per-line band tag; use it in contentLines/pickLine so every sim benefits. Content: activity lines per band. chat, gigReactions and songReactions for the 10 new members (rox, benny, moth, chase, lenny, tamara, travis, earl, clementine, duke).

findings.assumes: The Monday deck is driven by content, and every g() card in cards.js is gated to hail_damage + metal. Probe (8 seeds x 3 yrs): other bands draw 10-15 cards against 67 for Hail Damage, with about 60 of 72 weeks having no card. They get about half the fans (Frost Heave 1418, Ramblers 1722, Gravel Kings 2098 against Hail Damage 3152) and less money.
findings.needs: A Monday deck per band: drama, money, scene, weird, guilt, local and signed cards plus one storyline chain each (the Cape Saga equivalent), or generic cards written with role tokens. After that, rerun balance for each band.

findings.assumes: The hustle grumbler is activities.js grumbler 'marcel'. It silently falls back to the first member (Rox, Chase, Travis).
findings.needs: A per-band grumbler, either a member flag in bands.js or a map in activities keyed by bandId.

findings.assumes: The hard-coded MILESTONES text fans250 is 'The Gopher Hole knows your name', a Saskatoon venue. localHeroes says 'the garage era is over'. FALLBACK yearEnd says 'Another year in the garage'. lines.milestones does not exist in content, so every band sees these.
findings.needs: Neutral or tokenised milestone text ({homeVenue}, {space}), or per-band lines.milestones in content.

findings.assumes: songs.reactions hard-codes marcel (names the song), dana (solo), jaxon (fills) and kenji (nod), plus the French-title sigh. Probe: 100% of songs written by Frost Heave, Gravel Kings and the Ramblers get no reactions.
findings.needs: Reactions by role (namer = gig.roles.front, solo wanter = roles.solo, fill sneaker = roles.fill, quiet/nod = a 'silent' member flag), or a per-band reaction table with per-band triggers. Examples: Benny refuses a third chord when difficulty is high; Lenny says 'sounds like a famous riff' when songs.similarity is high; Earl 'played on the original'; Duke's hat. Content for 10 members.

findings.assumes: The title gag (withSuffix/marcelIn L443) is Marcel-only French. The punk, rock and country pools in content/song_titles.js have 8 titles each against 46 for metal. Bots write about 30 songs in 3 years, so non-metal bands hit 'II'/'III' sequels after about 8 songs. 'Snow Route Parking Ban' duplicates a Tundra Wraith song.
findings.needs: Content: about 40 titles per genre. Optional per-band title quirk hook (e.g. Lenny's '(Legally Distinct)'). The sequencer's reroll label 'Another title from Marcel' needs a band-neutral version.

findings.assumes: The only frontman stage moment is capeSpin (capeOn L206, cfg capeCombo L196, reaction lines L653). It needs flags.cape from the Hail Damage Cape Saga, so other bands have no frontman moment. The drama spotlight RULE (27_sim_drama L132) keys off capeSpin as well.
findings.needs: A per-band signature moment defined in content (bands.js member.signature {id, combo, flag?, lines}). Examples: Rox's council rant, Chase's knee slide or leather pants, Duke's hat toss. Generalise session, finishLive, the RULES spotlight and gig:band actions to use it.

findings.assumes: LIVE_LINES are hard-coded in Hail Damage voices: the solo line 'saw Norway' (Dana), the fill line 'i did a fill. you kept up' (Jaxon's lowercase voice), and capeSpin. Other bands' solo and fill players (Benny, Lenny, Earl, Moth, Tamara, Clementine) get these lines.
findings.needs: Move them to content per band or role (lines.live[bandId]) and give each soloist and filler their own lines.

findings.assumes: The 'mosh' crowd moment fires for every genre at combo 30. There is only one genre moment per genre (GENRE_MOMENT L203, at crowd >= 85). The v0.9 roadmap item 'genre moments' is not built.
findings.needs: A per-genre moment table from content: punk stage dive or circle pit, rock lighters and encore, country two-step and yeehaw. Each needs thresholds, crowd deltas, result lines and a genre variant of the mosh moment.

findings.assumes: Only tundra_wraith has a cast. castMembers defaults corpsePaint to true and stageShirt to black (L122). syncLineup always puts defectors in corpse paint (L178). Probe: rival.members is empty for Mall Rats, Chartbusters and Buckle & Boot, so the Battle of the Bands rival set has no band on stage.
findings.needs: Content casts per the owner decisions: Mall Rats (Blaze/Kevin from Oakville, the bassist who never plugs in, the jawline drummer, Siobhan the stylist), Chartbusters (Rex Glamour with the July scarf, drummer Steve #5, etc.), Buckle & Boot (Brayden, Colt, the pickup-costume mascot). Each cast needs members, looks, songs, albums, rebrands, label and vehicle. Code: default corpsePaint to false and add a per-cast defector look (corpse / stylist makeover / rhinestones).

findings.assumes: lines(key) reads one global news pool, and it is all Tundra Wraith flavour (Gord, veggie trays, Winnipeg, 'pals from Saskatoon'). Probe: 'Mall Rats passed 1,000 fans. Gord posted...' and 'Buckle & Boot... fruit basket'.
findings.needs: Per-rival news (cast[rivalId].news[key] or news[rivalId][key], falling back to neutral) and news content for the 3 rivals.

findings.assumes: texts(kind) reads one global showdowns pool (botb, sameNight, stolenSlot, festival, loonies, poach, final), full of Gord and 'buddy'. Probe: 'Most of the scene picked your show. Chartbusters texted... buddy'.
findings.needs: showdowns[rivalId][kind] with a neutral fallback, plus content for 3 rivals.

findings.assumes: Rival cards use fixed ids: rv_poach (L444), rv_crack_<kind> (L631) and rv_final_eve. Their text is Gord and Tundra Wraith ('Tundra Wraith Break Up', speaker wraith_frontman) and they are dealt to every band (probe: 'Buddy!' rv_poach for Frost Heave, Gravel Kings and the Ramblers).
findings.needs: Resolve the card id per rival (cast.cards map or '<id>_<rivalId>', falling back to the base id), a frontman npc per rival in npcs.js, and 3 x 5 cards.

findings.assumes: The showdown setlist falls back to ['Eternal Winter'] (probe: 'Eternal Winter' x3 for all 3 new rivals). BPM is rng.int(150,220) for every genre (L504). Album release falls back to 'Eternal Winter' (L225); probe: Mall Rats release 'Eternal Winter (Deluxe)'. The label falls back to 'monolith' (L210).
findings.needs: Cast songs, albums and label for each rival. Set BPM from GG.content.genres[rival.genre].tempo.

findings.assumes: The scene leaderboard adds every filler row, including mall_rats_scene, chartbusters_scene and buckle_boot_scene. When one of those is your rival it is listed twice (probe: 2 rows with the rival's name). Tundra Wraith has no filler row, so it disappears for other bands. All filler bands are in Saskatchewan or Winnipeg.
findings.needs: Skip scene rows that match the current rival (by name or logo.same). Add a tundra_wraith_scene filler. Consider Alberta filler bands for Gravel Kings.

findings.assumes: SCHEDULE.festival uses the rivalry festival venues from content. Their catch text literally says 'Tundra Wraith headline...', and genreFit FIT is metal-weighted (country 0.6). All festivals are in Saskatchewan and one is 'Queen City Mosh-Fest', even for country or rock rivals. Separately, world.shape (26_sim_world L363) adds 'frontman... calls you buddy. Twice.' when you open for any rival.
findings.needs: Use {rival} in catch text, set per-genre fit, add an Alberta festival for Gravel Kings, give festivals genre variety, and move the opening line into the rival cast.

findings.assumes: speechCard/speech ignore the card's gate {band:['hail_damage']}. Every band gets Marcel's speech (speaker marcel, 'Thank the moose', 'Take a shot at Tundra Wraith'; probe confirms 'loonie_speech/marcel' for all four). speechWorstVan (Kenji, Moose Hearse) behaves the same. FALLBACK_SPEECHES (L140) are moose/Tundra too. The wraithFeud flag feeds rival heat (23_sim_rival L733).
findings.needs: Check gatePasses. Support per-band speech and worst-van cards (awards.speech as a list or bandId map). Write content for 3 bands. Use a generic rivalFeud flag.

findings.assumes: All outfitCards are gated to hail_damage (cape-aware), so outfitCard returns null for other bands. They get no red-carpet moment, silently.
findings.needs: Per-band red-carpet outfit cards (Rox, Chase's leather pants, Duke's hat, etc.). The UI must tolerate null in the meantime.

findings.assumes: rivalThanks/rivalLoses are keyed by rival id, but only tundra_wraith has content. Other rivals fall back to FALLBACK_THANKS ('Tundra Wraith win...', L148) and a literal 'Tundra Wraith give you a standing ovation' (L1238). otherNominees (L1166) falls back to FALLBACK_OTHERS, metal and prairie joke bands, for every genre.
findings.needs: Neutral {rival} fallbacks, rivalThanks and rivalLoses content for the 3 rivals, and awards.nominees per genre (the {genre:[...]} shape is already supported).

findings.assumes: Label demands copy lab.demands with no band or genre filter. Monolith's 'english' demand is 'Marcel should sing in English', and image/radio carry cards gated to hail_damage; Gopherwood's showcase card has speaker baba. For other bands the carded demand never settles: the weekly check at L1049-1055 only auto-settles demands with no card, and pendingDemand skips carded ones. Those demands hang forever.
findings.needs: A band/genre filter on demands or per-band variants. Settle 'half' when a demand's card can never pass its gate. Write signed_* cards for 3 bands.

findings.assumes: studioEvent draws from albumWords.studioEvents. Many of these have Hail Damage member speakers (dana, jaxon, marcel, kenji, baba) and no band gate. Probe: Gravel Kings got studio_dana_take_41 and studio_nail_salon. The studios moms_basement and strip_mall_sound are fixed to Saskatoon.
findings.needs: Band gates on member studio events and per-band studio events. A generic sim guard that rejects any card whose speaker is a member id missing from the band. Set studio city to {city} or per band.

findings.assumes: callHome excludes 'kenji' by id. Its pools are keyed by member id (Hail Damage only), and the generic pool says 'It's 4 a.m. in Saskatoon'. Tour chat lines are also Hail Damage: lines.depart.japan (Marcel's cape) and .russia (Jaxon, Baba) at L467; lines.home ('Moose Hearse', 'Back in Saskatoon') at L597; lines.rival ('Tall accountant? Veggie tray?') at L696. The Paris roses line at L405 is Marcel-only.
findings.needs: callHome for the 10 new members, and {city}/{van}/{rival} tokens in the depart, home and rival lines (or per-band variants). Optional per-band city moments, e.g. Clementine in Montréal or Paris.

findings.assumes: wt_homesick is force-queued for every band. Its speaker is dana and it has no gate, so Dana speaks in Frost Heave, Gravel Kings and Ramblers careers. The world cards wt_uk_rain ('the cape is wet') and wt_au_spider (both speaker dana) are also ungated.
findings.needs: Queue wt_homesick with q.who set to a talking member and use speaker 'recruit', or add per-band variants. Band-gate the member-voiced world cards and write region cards for 3 bands.

findings.assumes: The World-era payoff is the Moose Opera: the Helsinki package with needs 'moose' (L293/303), moose() (L640), and the Gong 'moose' bonus (L710). All of it requires flags.mooseAlbum from Marcel's moose chain, so other bands have no World payoff and a weaker Gong case.
findings.needs: A per-band World payoff: package.needs keyed to a band flag, plus a storyline chain and cards for each band. Otherwise, rebalance the Gong without the moose bonus.

findings.assumes: When the designated driver returns, syncDriver posts the 'back behind the wheel' chat as 'jaxon', hard-coded. Probe: jaxon appears in the Frost Heave, Gravel Kings and Ramblers group chats.
findings.needs: Post the line as the returning driver (cur). The per-driver back and takeOver lines already exist in content.drivers.

findings.assumes: defaultVan uses id 'moose_hearse' and name 'The Moose Hearse' for every band. driverFor falls back to 'kenji' for hail_damage (L478). 25_sim_tour L428/451 also falls back to 'kenji'. shop.vanName falls back to 'The Moose Hearse' (2a L319-322). shop.init renames the van for new careers, but world.migrate and defaultVan still produce the Hail Damage name and id.
findings.needs: defaultVan should use GG.shop.vanName(bandId, 0) and a neutral id, and drop the 'kenji' fallbacks.

findings.assumes: Van banter pools are keyed by member id (Hail Damage only), and the silent-bassist gag is hard-wired to the 'kenji' id (L552, L558). Other bands get no van banter. The afterGig pickLine keys (breakdown, vanTired, genreClash, sameCrowd, venueBanned; L336 and on) are content lines with 'Moose Hearse' and 'Kenji' in them. The highway fallback 'Hwy 7 · the Trans-Canada' (L577) is the Saskatoon-to-Calgary route, which is wrong from Edmonton.
findings.needs: vanBanter for 10 members, a 'silent' member flag in bands.js instead of the id, {van}/{driver} tokens in the road lines, and a per-home highway for off-map venues.

findings.assumes: Road cards are drawn through gates, but many Hail Damage-voiced road cards have no band gate. Probe: road_cape_door, road_babas_lunch, road_mosquitoes, road_lead_foot, road_gas_argument, road_fowl_supper, road_banjo_hitchhiker and road_wrong_turn all appeared for other bands.
findings.needs: Gate those cards to hail_damage. Add per-band road cards (Moth's apartment, T-Bone versus Chase's cassettes, Earl's historical markers) and you-drive cards.

findings.assumes: The want RULES are Hail Damage only: spotlight (capeSpin), cape, solos, practice, freedom, baba, and mystery (weighted by kenjiDrift, L22/L158). content drama.members defines only marcel, dana, jaxon and kenji, so new members have no wants and no personal mood driver. Grumble and passive lines (stagePool L181) fall back to the generic recruit pool.
findings.needs: New rules plus drama.members content for the 10 members. Examples: Rox council (promote/buzz), Benny two chords (easy songs), Moth van (van condition, no rentals), Chase 1985, Lenny lawsuits (song similarity), Tamara curfew (low burnout, short drives), Travis truck, Earl stories (long drives), Clementine never caught enjoying it, Duke hat (merch/buzz). Rename kenjiDrift to mysteryDrift.

findings.assumes: When an original member has no exit definition, quit() marks them 'gone' with returnDue null and they never return. The ultimatum card falls back to ult_recruit. Probe (8 seeds x 3 yrs): other bands average 3.8-4.8 quits and 0 returns, against 2.8 quits and 1.0 returns for Hail Damage. In one Ramblers seed all four originals were gone by year 3.
findings.needs: Exit storylines per member: quitLine, beats, backLine, away, needBuzz, returnAfter, plus ultimatum, return and returnFilled cards in dramaCards. Then rebalance quit rates for each band.

findings.assumes: hireFillIn looks up fill-ins by exact role string. The roles 'vocals/guitar', 'guitar', 'vocals/acoustic' and 'fiddle' fall back to F.any ('Dwayne from the music store', 'Cousin Dale, somehow').
findings.needs: Normalise roles (split on '/', map 'guitar' to lead guitar) and add fiddle and acoustic fill-in pools, flavoured by genre.

findings.assumes: Recruit candidates draw traits and quirks from one pool with no genre filter; the quirks include metal and Baba-flavoured ones such as polka-metal. Names and shirt colours per genre already work.
findings.needs: A genre/band filter on traits and quirks ({genres:[...]}) and genre-flavoured quirk content for punk, rock and country. This is the roadmap item 'genre-flavoured recruit pools'.

findings.assumes: cal.monday posts calendar.news[week] as its 'who' (jaxon, dana, marcel, baba) for every band. Probe: jaxon, dana and marcel lines in other bands' chat. Calendar result lines are Hail Damage too: the Halloween costume line 'six Marcels', NYE 'Jaxon kisses his guitar', and clearOutdoor 'lawn chairs'.
findings.needs: Per-band season news (news[bandId][week]), or skip lines whose who is not in the band or an npc. Tokenise or split the holiday and weather lines.

findings.assumes: Weather affinity is hard-coded: when it hails, bandId === 'hail_damage' gets +5 crowd and the hailBand lines (L219).
findings.needs: A per-band weather affinity from content (e.g. bands.js weather: {kind, crowd, lines}), such as Frost Heave with snow or spring thaw potholes. Optional.

findings.assumes: The rival leaves a comment on every Bandbook post, drawn from the single CM.rival / rivalExclusive pool, which is supportive Tundra Wraith 'buddy' text. rivalName falls back to 'Tundra Wraith' (L94).
findings.needs: comments.rival[rivalId] with a fallback, and content for Mall Rats (sponsor spam), Chartbusters (PR copy) and Buckle & Boot (truck emoji).

findings.assumes: 'kenji' is hard-coded as the silent member in many places: fans speakerFor (L116-117), cringe and viral (L260-268, with the HD preference lists at L268, L297 and L395), 2c_sim_licensing speakerFor (L59), 2d_sim_recap gig quote (L63) and goodYear (L196), 25_sim_tour callHome (L602), and 26_sim_world banter (L552). The cringe pool 'who' ids and the scandals list (L228) are Hail Damage members only.
findings.needs: A single band-content flag (member.silent) and a helper such as GG.career.talkers(state) used by every sim. Per-band cringe, viral and scandal content and cards.

findings.assumes: 'Dale from Warman' (a Saskatoon satellite) is the start superfan for every band, with the fixed id 'dale'. He is in the gig lines (L490-497), comments (L178), superfan cards fans_dale_hello and fans_macaroni (L537-539; macaroni_kenji needs kenji), and the shop merch line 'Dale bought one' (2a L642). Probe: 'Dale from Warman made it to Regina'.
findings.needs: A per-band home superfan: keep the state slot 'dale' but resolve name, lines, comments and gifts from the band (e.g. a Regina local for Frost Heave), plus per-band gift cards.

findings.assumes: The shop chat() helper posts the same Hail Damage line from the first active member when the scripted 'who' is not in the band. So Rox says 'My mirror is coming with us' and talks about 'HALE DAMAGE shirts'. This covers the lines outro, solo, misprintCollector, move, van, merchUnlock and evicted. content/shop.js sections.solo is described as 'Dana's spotlight'.
findings.needs: Per-band lines (lines[bandId] falling back to lines), or skip the line when the who is missing. Write the content for 3 bands.

findings.assumes: The forced shop cards use fixed ids (shop_space_N, shop_solo, shop_merch_start, shop_pawn_kit, shop_van_deal, money_merch_misprint), all gated to Hail Damage through cards.js g(). shop_solo also requires isActive 'dana' (L688; also L803). Other bands therefore get no space offers, no merch start, no used-van deal and no misprint gag (misprintDue L499); solo only arrives through the soloAutoWeeks path.
findings.needs: Look cards up per band (card(id+'_'+bandId) || card(id)), replace 'dana' with gig.roles(s).solo, and give each band a misprint (e.g. 'FORST HEAVE'). Write the card content.

findings.assumes: makeOffer filters brands by genre only. The 'insurance' brand is Marcel's employer (speaker marcel, all its text is about Marcel), but its country, rock and punk weights are above 0, so the Ramblers, Gravel Kings and Frost Heave can receive it.
